decision.reason: The exact 1.592329--1.599726x vector-operation screen is below M74's own 2x gate. Pair selection affects only 6.007--6.470% of partition vectors, while the uncharged matcher performs 1.244--13.686 billion 16-bit Hamming comparisons and selected PWP traffic rises to 1.287--1.306 GB over the heldout cohort.

independent_method.heldout_source: M40 H67 ep35 r6 positive packed planes, samples 5--9
independent_method.plane_decode: independent little-bit-order unpack plus explicit padded Conv3x3 im2col in C,KY,KX feature order
independent_method.source_conservation: every record independently matched im2col partition popcount to input-support valid-padding fanout
independent_method.search_reconstruction: stable nearest-center rank, beam first centers, all 16 second centers, plus-before-minus and center-index tie break
independent_method.arithmetic_reconstruction: direct coefficient-class L1 accounting for x-a-b and x-a+b, without importing M72/M74/M43

arithmetic_and_operation_audit.plus_identity: for every bit, residual=x-a-b and a+b+residual=x
arithmetic_and_operation_audit.minus_identity: for every bit, residual=x-a+b and a-b+residual=x
arithmetic_and_operation_audit.coefficient_magnitude_two_charge: verified as two unit vector operations in the selected-pair L1 cost
arithmetic_and_operation_audit.pair_cost: 2 PWP reads plus exact bitwise residual L1
arithmetic_and_operation_audit.candidate_operation_conservation: single reads + single correction + dual reads + dual correction + bit-sparse fallback == dual candidate operations for every operator, partition and beam
arithmetic_and_operation_audit.qualification: This proves algebra and abstract operation accounting, not matcher latency, accumulator-port timing, SRAM feasibility or energy.

hardware_cost_audit.required_pair_datapath: two simultaneous 1152-bit PWP reads plus signed add/subtract and residual accumulation, or explicit multi-cycle serialization

beam_selection_audit.verdict: Beams 2/4/16 are Pareto-rejected for hardware exploration. Beam1 retains 99.2254% of the beam16 total abstract operation improvement with one eleventh of its matcher comparisons.

nearest_hamming_below_2.qualification: exact on this internal heldout only

nearest_hamming_at_least_3.qualification: screening lead; operation saving and accuracy must be recomputed after gating

findings.finding: The reported ratios omit 48, 80, 144 and 528 16-bit Hamming comparisons per partition vector for beams 1, 2, 4 and 16. Even beam1 needs more than 72 comparisons/cycle merely to break even with bit-sparse under a one-comparison/one-vector-op stress normalization, and about 693 comparisons/cycle to retain 1.5x.
findings.impact: The 1.59--1.60x ratios are vector-operation screens, not plausible cycle speedups.
findings.required_repair: Freeze matcher microarchitecture and issue/latency/area model, add early gating, and report end-to-end candidate cycles with matcher and packer included.

findings.finding: Every selected pair correctly charges two abstract PWP operations, but no physical 2-read 144B SRAM path or traffic energy is modeled. Total selected PWP reads are 21.26--23.01% higher than the one-PWP reference.
findings.impact: A serialized implementation loses the abstract operation benefit; a parallel implementation requires two 1152-bit reads and additional banking/replication.
findings.required_repair: Stage the 2.304KB partition/output-block working set in an explicit two-read organization, charge refill and read energy, then run address-timed VCS and Synopsys A/B.

findings.finding: The best independently reproduced speedup is 1.599725819x, below M74's predeclared 2x internal vector-operation gate; improvement over the single-PWP candidate is only 1.064220607x.
findings.impact: There is insufficient headroom for matcher, SRAM, merge and control overhead.
findings.required_repair: Do not write RTL for the current search. Require at least 2x after matcher and memory charging on a train-derived catalog and independent holdout.

findings.finding: Centers use samples 0--4 and evaluation uses samples 5--9 from one frozen cohort; M72 explicitly marks validation/test data use and train_catalog_eligible=false.
findings.impact: No PAFT catalog, accuracy claim, independent validation speedup or DATE result is admitted.
findings.required_repair: Rebuild centers on a disjoint training trace, run PAFT, then evaluate unchanged gates on distinct sequences and density strata.

findings.finding: M72 labels source_population as local_DSEC_valid825_first_ten_samples, while its pinned manifest SHA e743364b is the M40 H67 ep35 S10 manifest and carries H67 ep35 checkpoint identity.
findings.impact: The arithmetic is unaffected, but provenance and algorithm-line naming are unsafe for publication.
findings.required_repair: Replace free-text source labels with exact manifest/checkpoint/dataset identities and fail validation on disagreement.

findings.finding: Beam16 performs 11x beam1 matcher comparisons but saves only 134,837 additional vector operations and increases speedup from 1.592329x to 1.599726x.
findings.impact: Beam depth above one has a strongly unfavorable hardware return.
findings.required_repair: Pareto-prune beams 2/4/16 and use beam1 only for subsequent algorithm experiments.

findings.finding: Only 6.007--6.470% of partition vectors choose a pair; 80.45--82.80% of selected pairs use plus and no selected pair uses the same center twice.
findings.impact: Most vectors pay pair-search availability without using the second PWP path, and no one-read same-center shortcut exists.
findings.required_repair: Gate pair search after first-stage distance and evaluate a plus-only/direct-pair ablation before retaining a general signed pair engine.

algorithm_feedback: Use beam1 as the only surviving search point; beams 2/4/16 are hardware Pareto-dominated.
Add a zero-loss-on-this-holdout early gate that skips pair search when nearest-center Hamming distance is below two, then validate it on disjoint data.

Screen a stronger distance>=3 gate: it searches only 12.1500% of vectors and captures 80.6137% of beam1 pair selections by count, but its operation benefit must be recomputed rather than inferred from count.
Train a direct residual-aware signed-pair catalog or pair-ID predictor so runtime does not perform beam*Q pair enumeration.
Bias PAFT/catalog training toward one-PWP exact hits and only retain pairs whose predicted correction saving repays the second 144B read and merge.
Run a plus-only ablation because plus accounts for about 80--83% of selected pairs; remove minus hardware unless its charged end-to-end gain survives.
Exploit the 2.304KB per-partition/output-block working set with explicit two-bank or replicated SRAM, but include duplication, refill, 1152-bit read energy and port conflicts.

Require train-derived centers, five-epoch PAFT, independent multi-sequence validation, address-timed matcher/PWP cycles, VCS arithmetic miter, DC/STA/SAIF/PTPX and same-resource baseline before reconsidering RTL.
admitted_claims: Exact internal-heldout vector-operation reconstruction for beams 1/2/4/16 with zero production mismatch.
Exact per-bit plus/minus signed decomposition and L1 coefficient-magnitude charging.
Exact two-PWP-read and aggregate operation conservation.
Beam1 is the only hardware-relevant algorithm follow-up point under the current evidence.
forbidden_claims: cycle-accurate, RTL-measured, memory-aware, energy, system or full-network speedup
train catalog, PAFT result, accuracy preservation or independent validation
SRAM macro feasibility, PPA, DATE headline or best-paper readiness
promotion of beam16 merely because it has the lowest abstract vector-operation count
